metadata.title: BC Building Code Amendments to NBC 2020
metadata.description: British Columbia-specific amendments to transform the National Building Code (NBC) 2020 into the BC Building Code
metadata.author: BC Building Code Team

amendment.description: Update section references in Division B objectives

sentence.text:
For the purpose of compliance with this Code as required in , the objectives and functional statements attributed to the acceptable solutions in Division B shall be the objectives and functional statements identified in
,
(See .)

amendment.description: Add reference to Sentence 9.7.4.3.(2) for climatic and seismic values

sentence.text: Except as provided in and as required by , the climatic and seismic values required for the design of buildings under this Code shall be in conformance with the values established by the authority having jurisdiction.

amendment.description: Add new sentence 5 for outside summer design temperatures

sentence.text: The outside summer design temperatures determined from shall be those listed for the July 2.5% dry values.

amendment.description: Change fire safety plan reference to BC Fire Code

sentence.text: Where a fire safety plan is required, it shall conform to Section 2.8. of Division B of the British Columbia Fire Code.
